The '''Industrial Explorer Outfit''' was a specialized suit designed to be worn in hazardous areas. This suit was capable of withstanding the harsh conditions of industrial wastelands like the sewers of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the enormous junkyards of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].

[[Galen Marek]] wore one such suit during his [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|mission]] on Raxus Prime.

==Behind the scenes==
The Industrial Explorer Outfit (called Raxus Prime Survival Gear in the game) is featured in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'' video game]]. On the Imperial Raxus Prime level it was the default costume that players started with and could choose to play in later on in the game. The life support system has a distinctive look to the ones on the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] outfit, and subtly incorporates elements from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] life support suit.
